title: Scholarship and Recipe
author: Astrid Dunmore
blurb: Jonah Quintana, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decide who to be when the labels come off before prom.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
